name: Gray Judge
source:
Near future where security structures are privatized. Sakura Genichiro works for a microscopic police company. He will resolve incidents together with his female companions.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
近未来，治安机构已经私有化。主人公供职于一家规模微小的警务公司，将与女同事们一同解决各种事件。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-january-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
